notes: Idea: move the tennis lift's jam-cutoff shunt from the MOSFET source (reads duty x I) into the motor-diode loop behind an INA186-class amp, so the trip no longer moves with the battery-held duty. Searched shunt 0.005-0.02 ohm x gain 25-200 x E24 divider: chose 0.01 ohm, 50 V/V, 33k; worst-margin score 1.04 -> 1.29; slide/trip 1.14x -> 1.42x at any floor; jams on the simulated feeder (real firmware) cut 49/59 ms vs 79/69. Verification: cad pytest (see PR), venture tests 122 passed, lift_jam_sweep --sense/--duty output in eval/. GPIO 0 strap check: backdrive current through the new shunt at most 0.16 A after a stop. cad suite: 137 passed + the lift class rerun (22 passed) after the two fixes; venture tests/ 122 passed.
